channel.title: Blockfront
channel.description: Blockfront reports crypto news: Bitcoin and Ethereum, DeFi protocols, exchanges, regulation, security incidents, funding rounds and network upgrades.

item.title: What does “settled” mean in CoW Explorer: Your order executed
item.description: What does settled mean in CoW Explorer? It means your order was executed on-chain; compare requested and executed amounts to see how much traded.

item.title: How do you find a completed token swap in CoW Explorer?
item.description: Find a completed token swap in CoW Explorer by searching its network for an order ID or wallet address, then confirm Filled and inspect execution amounts and settlement.

item.title: US authorizes seizure of $1.2 billion in Binance theft
item.description: The Justice Department says courts authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion from Binance’s October theft, while recovery work continues.

item.title: cbridge wallet not connecting: Fix the wallet handshake
item.description: cBridge wallet not connecting? Resolve extension clashes, hidden approvals, stale sessions or unsupported networks, then reconnect and confirm your address appears.

item.title: US court authorizes action on $1.2bn in stolen Binance crypto
item.description: The Justice Department says courts authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion from Binance’s $6 billion October theft; tracing and recovery continue.

item.title: Is Jumper bridge safe for a first transfer?
item.description: Is Jumper bridge safe? Broadly usable, but each transfer carries LI.FI contract risk and the selected bridge’s risk. Limit approvals and test with a small amount.

item.title: US wins court authority over $1.2bn in Binance theft
item.description: The Justice Department has court authority over more than $1.2 billion of crypto stolen from Binance, part of $2.7 billion frozen as recovery efforts continue.

item.title: US secures authority to seize $1.2 billion in Binance crypto
item.description: The Justice Department secured court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion stolen from Binance; efforts to trace and freeze the remaining funds continue.

item.title: US moves to seize $1.2 billion in Binance theft
item.description: The Justice Department says court-authorized action covers more than $1.2 billion of Binance funds, part of $2.7 billion frozen after an October theft.

item.title: US courts authorize seizure of $1.2 billion in Binance hack crypto
item.description: The Justice Department says courts have authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion from the Binance hack, as a wider freeze tops $2.7 billion.

item.title: Chainalysis says breach exposed tokens for all users
item.description: Chainalysis says an October intrusion exposed account data and live tokens for every user; its services went offline as it investigates and restores customer access.

item.title: Coinbase’s OCC Trust Bank Charter Takes Effect
item.description: Coinbase’s national trust bank charter became effective Nov. 6, putting its custody business under federal oversight while stopping short of deposit-taking and lending.

item.title: Deutsche Bank opens crypto custody to institutional clients
item.description: Deutsche Bank has opened crypto custody to paying institutional clients in Europe and agreed with Deutsche Asset Management to explore digital asset products.

item.title: Visa adds Monad as a stablecoin settlement option
item.description: Visa added Monad as a stablecoin settlement option on Nov. 10, giving participating issuers and acquirers another blockchain for settling obligations.

item.title: Coinbase’s National Trust Charter Takes Effect
item.description: Coinbase’s national trust company took effect Nov. 6 after OCC approval, putting its custody business under a federal framework without granting deposit-taking powers.

item.title: Coinbase wins final OCC approval for national trust charter
item.description: Coinbase’s national trust charter took effect Nov. 6, placing its custody business under federal oversight and opening a path to expand institutional services.

item.title: NYSE selects Avalanche for tokenized stock settlement
item.description: NYSE picked Avalanche to record and settle trades for its planned tokenized-securities venue, designed for 24/7 operation subject to regulatory approval.

item.title: ZetaChain Vote Sets Dec. 9 L1 Halt and ZETA Solana Move
item.description: ZetaChain holders approved a 1:1 ZETA migration to Solana, with the L1 set to halt at a snapshot block expected around Dec. 9, 2026.

item.title: Treasury orders U.S. firms to block MEXC transfers over $16B
item.description: FinCEN ordered U.S. financial firms to block transfers to and from MEXC, alleging the exchange handled at least $16 billion in illicit funds over five years.

item.title: Nigeria sets stablecoin licences, bans algorithmic tokens
item.description: Nigeria’s central bank set separate licences for naira and foreign-currency stablecoins, barred algorithmic tokens and gave operators 180 days to apply.
